entities.title: zazzle investigate
entities.summary: `zazzle investigate QUESTION --path P.. --symbol S..` (also `agent investigate`, MCP zazzle_investigate): the user's local model resolves a repository question with bounded read-only lookups, and the agent gets findings whose path:line citations zazzle checked against the files.
entities.purpose: mod.rs parses the command and resolves the starting symbols before any inference: their refs inside the scope and the bodies of their first two declarations are the first evidence, and a symbol with none gets real files and symbols in the scope that resemble it (seed.rs); when no symbol is there and nothing resembles any, it returns a no-evidence report without asking the model. It then asks the local model for up to three READ, REFS, OUTLINE or FIND lookups per turn, runs them through zazzle's own commands confined to the scope, never runs the same lookup twice (same file and range, or same words; the model is told it has the output or that it failed), and stops at its answer (FINDING and UNKNOWN lines, with or without an ANSWER line), at the turn limit, when the seen text passes ~12,000 tokens, on a second unusable reply (the first is shown back to it with the format), after two turns of only repeated lookups or on a model failure; a stop quotes how the last reply began. A run that gathered evidence but stopped without an answer (an empty answer, a lookup on the last turn, turns of only repeats or of neither lookups nor an answer) gets one answer-only turn; when no finding is verified the report is PARTIAL and carries ranked verbatim excerpts (each lookup's first line and the lines naming a word of the question or a starting symbol, two lines around them, lookups with more such lines first, each file line once, up to ~3,000 tokens) and the lookups that found nothing. The whole call ends within --seconds (default 90), waiting for the shared model included. A READ or OUTLINE of a file that does not exist is refused once for every range, with the real files and symbols in scope whose names resemble it. The rules for files the model reads come back as notes on a separate ledger (`SESSION>local`) and go into its system message, never into the evidence; the caller's own ledger gets the rules for the cited files. cite.rs reads the ANSWER block and checks each FINDING: inside a scope entry, an existing text file, a valid line range, then quotes up to 12 cited lines.
boundaries: Read-only: lookups are read, refs, outline and find, never edit or run.
A READ or OUTLINE outside the scope is refused and the refusal is shown to the model; REFS and FIND are run on the scope paths only.
The model's claims are not verified, only its citations: the report says so.
The model loads once: Model asks through daemon's shared worker (llm::ask), which stays loaded across the turns and after the run until ZAZZLE_LLM_IDLE seconds unused.
